legal_status.summary: DPRK national; IT worker charged in employer virtual-currency thefts. The June 30, 2025 indictment in United States v. Kim Kwang Jin et al., N.D. Ga. No. 1:25-cr-00291, names Chang Nam Il and the employment personas Bong Chee Shen and Peter Xiao.
legal_status.court: U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia
caveats: Charges are allegations; the subject is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty.

The routes /team/bong-chee-shen and /team/peter-xiao describe personas the indictment attributes to the same person. They are kept as separate pages pending editorial review of their images and legacy identifiers (Alex Shen, devneser, Brian Cho, assasinooz77), which the indictment does not address.
